trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlocks once every other trophy is done.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy. Requires completion of all robberies, shooting ranges, drone races, and Bret's Target Decks, plus various side activities.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (jumps, under-the-bridge flights, etc.).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade game, race, and stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Get a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge (42 golds across 12 ranges).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Play through Cal's fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete all five of Andy's mission strands.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the treasure recovery missions for Kenton.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete all five of Billy's mission strands at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Destroy all synthetic labs as requested by Tyrone.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots (meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts twice).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the animals on Bret's Target Decks.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots (landmarks, curiosities, sculptures, etc.).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star Wanted Level while with your partner and escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row while you're still wanted.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet at a boarding gate at VCIA and take off.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's back door and empty the safe undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 Bank Vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Box in an armored truck, blow the doors, and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation from each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Crash a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and escape.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Complete 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed at something on a second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Encounter a strange event or Easter egg in Leonida.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people down with a melee attack from a vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Rob banks and sell the marked bills to fences.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the real estate app.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Take stolen vehicles to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn and register them.
